drafted_from: workflow:run-one-drawn-gauntlet-case's own file, tools/workflows/recipes/run-one-drawn-gauntlet-case.json (its condition, wake and three steps), and the e2e skill's generated cases, kept in the person's own store in its own form
start_here: Say to your AI: "Turn on workflow:run-one-drawn-gauntlet-case's wake chosen--a-drawn-gauntlet-case-is-added, have my store tell me when a case is added to my example gauntlet, and add case 59 with call {\"address\": \"https://127.0.0.1/mcp\", \"runs_here\": false}." The workflow then makes the list call that case stands for and keeps the answer beside the case under k 59.
no_lists_because: It keeps nothing in lists: the cases and results are the person's own, kept in their own store in its own form, and the case arrives in the fact that wakes it.
instructions: 1. Keep the gauntlet in the person's own store, in its own form: its axes (domain, extremes, strange values, and `calls`, the list input each value stands for), its drawn cases (k, words, call, drawn_by) and its results (k, answered, run_by).

2. Draw the cases with the formula engine: the size formula (flat_map each axis to its value count, then op:core.product) and the draw formula (case k as one value per axis, index floor(k / stride) mod radix).
3. Have the store tell when a case is added (workflow:tell-me-when-something-changes), with route-each-row-change's a-row-changed on.
4. Turn on this workflow's wake chosen--a-drawn-gauntlet-case-is-added, then add the drawn cases.

5. Read the results: one per case, the whole answer of its call (or {error} when the door refused the call). A split is a result the gauntlet's property does not hold for; read it in the store's own language.

worked_examples.title: A case naming a private address is listed and refused, and its answer is kept
worked_examples.ask: Run the drawn case 59 of my example gauntlet.

fact.condition: a drawn gauntlet case is added

worked_examples.given: The store told a change of the example gauntlet's cases: op INSERT, key ex:59, after {"k":59,"call":{"address":"https://127.0.0.1/mcp","runs_here":false},"drawn_by":"draw formula"}; route-each-row-change chose this workflow for it.
worked_examples.hands_back: The answer kept beside case 59 in the example gauntlet's results: k 59, answered {"tools": [], "next": null, "unavailable": [{"source": "127.0.0.1", "unreachable": "The server did not answer: The address must be a public site, not this computer or a private network."}]}, run_by "workflow:run-one-drawn-gauntlet-case"; the step submits {k: 59, kept: true}.
